name: Nava Brahma Temples
description: Group of nine 7th-century Shiva shrines with rock-cut Nagara architecture.

name: Bala Brahmeswara Temple
description: Head shrine of the Nava Brahma group where the Jogulamba idol was hidden.

name: Archaeological Museum Alampur
description: Heritage museum housing ancient Chalukyan sculptures and inscriptions.

name: Alampur Pushkar Ghat
description: Sacred river bank steps looking over the Krishna and Tungabhadra confluence.

name: Papanasi Temples
description: Historic cluster of 23 smaller square-plan Phamsana style shrines.

name: Sri Sangameshwara Temple
description: Sacred site positioned directly at the geographic merger of the twin rivers.

name: Kurnool Konda Reddy Buruju
description: Massive 12th-century military watchtower fortress in Kurnool city center.

name: Beechupally Anjaneya Swamy Temple
description: Ancient riverside Hanuman shrine situated next to the Nizam Konda fort.

name: Gadwal Fort
description: Historic medieval mud-and-stone fort famous for its giant brass cannon.
